title: World Bloom — In an Ephemeral Embrace — Episode3 Friends

meta.Event Outline: Several days before the meeting in the Asahina family household, the members of Nightcord at 25:00 notice something strange happening to the tree in their SEKAI. They each soon find themselves dreaming of very different lives.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's nice that I'm in the same class as my two closest friends again, but I haven't talked to most of the others.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I can't just stand here staring at my feet forever.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I should start by greeting everyone...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Morning, Kanade!
I'm so glad we're in the same class again!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Let's make this year another great one.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
I feel so much better knowing that you two are here.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha. It's pretty awkward when you're surrounded by a bunch of unfamiliar faces, huh. I'm glad we're together again too!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: I'm so glad that we're in the same class again this year, Mafuyu! Let's have lots of fun together!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm also looking forward to this upcoming year. But you need to make an effort to do your homework on your own, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm in the same class as Asahina...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What a surprise to see we're in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
But I'm also a little happy.
I was hoping to get to know you a little better.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I look forward to being your classmate.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This part needs to have more of a skip to its step...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, this sounds good.
Now, the next part should give the listener a sense of clarity...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Was someone singing just now...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Or did I just imagine that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But that gentle voice sounded so real.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm, for that feeling I just had...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
I thought we could have dinner soon.
Do you have any requests?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's already that late?
I'm sorry. I completely forgot...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I finished working early today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Your music sounds like you're having more fun than usual today, so I didn't want to interrupt your work.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: W-Was it really coming through that clearly?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Yes, your music was especially bouncy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We were assigned to new classes today, and I'm in the same class as a girl I've been wanting to talk to for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel like maybe we could be friends.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: That's a nice twist of fate.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Kanade! You uploaded that new song last night, right?! It's so good!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You came up with another really fun song. I got all excited just listening to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I got to work on it the second I got home, so I was worried it might feel a little rushed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm glad you both like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: What?! You made it that fast?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
You really are amazing...
You make such good music, and so fast too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. You three seem to be having fun.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina, you gotta listen to this!
Kanade's new song is really awesome!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, Yoisaki, you write your own songs?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Kanade's really amazing!
She posts her songs online as “K”, and she's super popular!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Really now?
I do like listening to music, so I'd love to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Of course...!
Um, this is my latest one...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I really like this other one too! Give it a listen!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to hear it.
